subject: general
question: _______ is one of the most important festivals of Kamakhya temple of Guwahati. It is held every year during the monsoon (mid-June) season, when the temple is closed for three days for tantric rites.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ambubachi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ambubachi Mela:

 
 
• It is celebrated at Kamakhya Temple in the month of June.
 
• It is one of the biggest congregations in eastern India.
 
• It is the belief that Kamakhya embodies the mother cult, the Shakti.
 
• The meaning of Ambubachi is* spoken with water.*
 
 
 
• Other fairs and festival of Assam: Bihu Festival, Me-Dum-Me-Phi, Majuli Festival, Dehing Patkai Festival, Kaziranga Elephant Festival and Ali Ai Ligang Festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Festival
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Bihu
 
 
**Bihu **is a set of **three cultural festivals** celebrated in **Assam**, marking the **Assamese New Year and the arrival of spring.**

 
 

 
 
 

 Baishagu
 **Baishagu** is a spring festival celebrated by the **Bodo community in Assam**, symbolizing unity, peace, and prosperity.
 
 

 Me-Dum-Me-Phi
 **Me-Dum-Me-Phi **is an important festival of the** Ahom community in Assam,** honoring departed ancestors and seeking their blessings for the **well-being of the family.**
